entries.heading: Senior Product Data Analyst | Crate & Canopy Home | 2022 – Present

items.text: Wrote complex SQL queries using multi-stage CTEs and window functions across 4B+ clickstream rows in Snowflake and GCP BigQuery to model D1/D7/D30 cohort retention and 24-month customer LTV.
Designed A/B feature experiments, sample-size power calculations, guardrail metric checks, and CUPED variance reduction in Python (SciPy, statsmodels) across 40+ checkout and onboarding launches.
Architected governed LookML views and Explores in Looker and built 22 self-serve Tableau executive dashboards tracking MRR, involuntary churn, and activation, cutting ad-hoc data requests by 47%.

Pinpointed a 19% mobile drop-off between address entry and payment confirmation by mapping step-by-step user journey paths, driving a simplified single-page flow that lifted paid subscribers by 3.4 percentage points.
Maintained 85+ incremental dbt models with YAML schema assertions (unique, not_null, accepted_values) and lineage documentation in Snowflake.
Defined Segment client-side and server-side event tracking schemas and an audited Amplitude taxonomy for 140+ product actions, eliminating duplicate revenue counting across iOS and web.
Authored weekly executive experimentation readouts and partnered with PMs, UX researchers, and backend engineers to prioritize quarterly checkout roadmap bets.

Replaced 6 hours of weekly manual spreadsheet updates with scheduled Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) scripts that decomposed week-over-week metric movements and posted automated anomaly alerts to Slack.
Sparked cross-company adoption of standardized experiment pre-registration templates and hypothesis scorecards across 6 product pods.
Presented deep-dive churn survival analyses at monthly company all-hands, directly informing the launch of a pause-subscription retention offer that saved $1.1M ARR.
Tuned slow analytical window queries on the production Postgres read replica and refactored 35 legacy reporting views into modular dbt staging tables.
Segmented referral-channel cohorts in Mixpanel and SQL to identify high-churn trial signups, reallocating $180k in quarterly paid social spend toward higher-LTV cohorts.
Analyzed how price-sensitive cohorts react to dynamic paywall copy and delivery-fee thresholds across mobile and web checkouts.
Built and launched an interactive Streamlit pricing-tier simulator in 48 hours for the annual executive sales offsite.
Built a lightweight Python Flask webhook service that ingested Qualtrics post-delivery survey payloads and wrote normalized rows into BigQuery.
Created geo-coded delivery zone polygons in GeoJSON and Folium to visualize courier dispatch bottlenecks across 12 metro areas.
Analyzed smart-thermostat HVAC airflow sensor readings for a seasonal home-energy partner co-marketing study.
Chaired the biweekly open-source data governance and metric council to reconcile finance and product active-subscriber definitions.
Refinished a mid-century walnut tableau cabinet and organized the team's annual charity silent auction.
Published an internal Quarto cookbook on Bayesian vs. frequentist sequential testing trade-offs for product managers.
